title: work:pr names the PR in its records before it opens
goal: Opening a PR for a record needs no follow-up commit to name it
acceptance: work:pr predicts the next GitHub number, writes it into each record and opens the PR in one commit
A taken number is renamed in a follow-up commit and reported
Refuses the default branch, a dirty tree, no records and --head/--repo; fixture tests
privacy: Tool and procedure text only; fixtures invented; no personal data.
escalation: A PR number that cannot be confirmed is renamed in a follow-up commit, never left wrong

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-24 at agent speed; implemented 2026-11-24, review, CI and release remain. Closed 2026-11-24.
